facts: Step definitions are PHP 8 attributes on public context methods: `#[Given('/^regex$/')]`, `#[When(...)]`, `#[Then('plain text with :placeholder')]`. Both plain-text and `/^regex$/` patterns are used, and a single method may carry several attributes.
`#[Transform(...)]` methods on Transform contexts convert a captured string into an object, typically by repository lookup.
The scenario's `Background` steps run first; most are answered by the retained Setup contexts, but a few are answered only by the Api contexts you are writing.

Contexts are Symfony services. The harness registers every class you return as `public`, `autowired` and `autoconfigured`. If a constructor argument cannot be autowired (Sylius wires many collaborators by service id, e.g. `@sylius.behat.api_platform_client.shop`, `@sylius.behat.api_platform_client.admin`, `@sylius.behat.shared_storage`), return an extra file named `behat_services.yml` containing a Symfony `services:` block with explicit `arguments:` for your classes.

Requests are issued through the retained `Sylius\Behat\Client\ApiClientInterface` (`ApiPlatformClient`, wired over Symfony's `test.client`, in-process) together with `RequestFactoryInterface` and `ResponseCheckerInterface`. The shared clipboard between steps is `Sylius\Behat\Service\SharedStorageInterface` (`->set($key, $value)`, `->get($key)`).

Suites are tag-filtered and a scenario is reachable only through its suite: alongside the classes you return, the harness registers the retained Setup, Transform and Hook contexts of the API suite whose tag filter matches the scenario's feature tag plus `@api`.

Production namespaces are `Sylius\Component\*` and `Sylius\Bundle\*`. Put your classes under `src/Sylius/Behat/Context/Api/**`. Removal took that directory with the code, so it does NOT exist yet -- create the path you need.

This workspace supports reading, searching, editing, and syntax parsing. It is a provisioned application runtime for the code in `./repo`; nothing here is executed by the harness. The harness executes your final submitted test artifacts against a separate, complete implementation after generation ends. You receive no harness execution feedback during generation.
TARGET_CONTRACTS.md contains the reviewed public API and configuration supplement supplied in every visibility view. It is context for writing tests; edits to it are not submitted.
Implementation visibility: the reviewed target bodies, including behavior-bearing delegated helpers, are hidden; declarations and permitted surrounding implementations remain visible.
environment.platform: the Sylius e-commerce platform (PHP 8.3, Symfony 7, API Platform)
environment.retained: the retained Sylius Behat substrate (Setup, Transform and Hook contexts, the API client and shared storage)
environment.run: `behat-scenario <feature file>:<line>` runs one Scenario in this workspace.

rules: Only files under `repo/src/Sylius/Behat/` are accepted. Repo-wide removal deleted those directories, so create whatever path you need; `Context/Setup`, `Context/Transform`, `Context/Hook`, `Client` and `Service` are what remains.
Production code is never accepted. Anything you change outside `repo/src/Sylius/Behat/` is discarded.
If a constructor argument cannot be autowired, a file `repo/behat_services.yml` is read as a Symfony `services:` block for your classes.

feature.background:
Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And there is a promotion "Christmas sale"
        And it is coupon based promotion
        And I am logged in as an administrator
feature.narrative:
In order to quickly create specific number of coupons for my promotions
    As an Administrator
    I want to be able to generate coupons for promotion
feature.title: Generating new coupons

scenario.gherkin:
Scenario: Generating new coupons without expiration date
        When I want to generate new coupons for this promotion
        And I choose the amount of 5 coupons to be generated
        And I specify their code length as 6
        And I limit generated coupons usage to 25 times
        And I generate these coupons
        Then I should be notified that they have been successfully generated
        And there should be 5 coupons related to this promotion
scenario.title: Generating new coupons without expiration date
